title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
三分天下诸葛亮、一统江山刘伯温。虽然夸张了一点，但是作为被朱元璋认为‘吾之子房’的刘伯温，在大明建立的过程中起到了极大的作用。他是元朝的进士、仕途不顺数次辞官回乡归隐，被朱元璋数次邀请才来辅佐。大明的文官之首一直都是李善长，但是以刘伯温、宋濂、汪广洋为首的浙东文官集团，一直都是大明文官系统的绝对主力。而朱元璋和马秀英一直催促马寻成亲，原因也非常简单。岁数到了自然就要成亲，成家立业、传宗接代，这可是重要的任务。如今这年代十五六岁成亲的大把都是，马寻都二十岁了，依然形单影只，朱元璋和马秀英看着都着急。马寻忧心忡忡的，难道是要先结婚后恋爱？还没有反应过来，他得到了一个官职——帐前都尉。被叫到坤宁宫的马寻问道，“姐，我没什么本事、也没功劳，得一官职叫什么事？”马秀英笑着开口，“给你你就接着，看你也不想当文官。俺和你姐夫商量了一下，先给你个军职，你去历练一下，以后好封候拜将。”马寻顿时压力山大，“姐，我不通军事，哪能去带兵打仗？”马秀英连忙说道，“谁让你带兵打仗了？家里还指望你传宗接代，哪能让你上战场？你以后就练兵、检阅，替你姐夫犒赏大军。”马寻明白了，这就是给他个官职混军功呢。马秀英眉开眼笑的说道，“今天见着刘伯温的闺女，模样生的好、性情也好。”马寻也无力抵抗，只能说道，“我能去看看吗？要是合适就成亲，要是看不顺眼的话，咱们就再找一找？”马秀英果断答应，“明天让沐英跟你过去，你亲自看看也好。”马寻又提出意见，“我要是成亲了，是不是住出去更合适一些？反正都在京城，也在姐眼皮子底下，随时能过来。”马秀英不高兴了，问道，“是觉得俺们对你不好？”“好，好的狠！”马寻就赶紧说道，“就是我野习惯了，在宫里总是觉得处处不得劲。我想游山玩水、想四处走走看看，在宫里哪都不能去。”马秀英更加不高兴了，“给你手令、宫符，你四处走走，谁还能拦着你？”马寻赶紧说道，“姐，这是皇宫，我哪能真的到处乱跑？再说了，我都要成家了，总不能住在宫里吧？别人知道了，得怎么笑话我？”这一下说到了马秀英的心坎上，让马寻一直都住在宫里确实不合适。现在让他住在这里就是权宜之计，只是因为朱元璋和马秀英不放心马寻一个人在京城。朱元璋迈着大步来了，“怎么了？你俩吵嘴了？”“小弟想搬出去。”马秀英就说道，“俺想了想，小弟真要是成亲，肯定也不好一直住在宫里。

他又想四处游走，你说如何是好？”朱元璋下意识的想要问问马寻是不是‘狼心狗肺’，可是转念间也能理解。马寻岁数小，而且住在宫里也不方便。最主要的是住在姐夫家，肯定会觉得不自在。朱元璋琢磨了一下说道，“那给你找个府邸，安排些人过去伺候。你也别只想着玩，大明初建，现在北边还在打仗，你也该出力。”马寻看向马秀英，试探着问道，“姐，你是不是偶有胸闷、气短？”马秀英愣了一下问道，“你怎么知道的？”马寻紧张了，立刻追问，“夜间和凌晨的时候更是如此？发热、盗汗，心跳得快不说，还时常耳鸣？”这一下轮到朱元璋紧张了，“小弟，怎么回事？你咋知道这些？”马寻心里有不好的预感，不过还是说话有所保留，“老头以前也这样，说咱家祖上也有些如此。说是气疾。”朱元璋和马秀英脸色大变，气疾这玩意儿他们可听说过。这也就是哮喘的一种说法，只是马寻现在也不敢确定，尤其是这玩意儿即使是几百年后也没办法根除，而且有一定的遗传基因。朱元璋脸色铁青，“小弟，你可别吓唬俺！”“姐夫，这事情我哪敢胡说！”马寻就说道，“这些天我一直在琢磨这事，不说肯定不行。只是万全的法子，我现在也想不出来。”朱元璋一时间有些失去了理智，“太医院那些酒囊饭袋，朕要砍了他们脑袋！”“行了，朱重八！”马秀英恢复理智，“太医院的那些人你又不是不知道，涉及你我，他们都是抱着无功无过即可，岂能下药？我现在好着，他们就说我没病。真的是病厉害了，他们就说药石难治。”朱元璋眼睛都红了，气的直喘粗气。马秀英看向马寻，问道，“小弟，听你的意思是这病治不好？”马寻面色凝重的点头，“都说根除难，只是控制一下不算难，对寿数的影响也不大。”“治不好算什么？”朱元璋暴怒，呵斥道，“俺这就召天下最好的郎中，朕倒是要看看这病到底能不能治好！”马秀英嗓门高了一些，“朱重八！有完没完！气疾是什么，你心里没数？”

Zhuge Liang divided the world into three parts, and Liu Bowen unified the country.Although it is a bit exaggerated, Liu Bowen, who was considered by Zhu Yuanzhang as 'my son', played a great role in the establishment of the Ming Dynasty.He was a Jinshi in the Yuan Dynasty. He resigned several times and returned to his hometown to live in seclusion after his official career failed. He was invited by Zhu Yuanzhang several times to assist him.The head of the civil service in the Ming Dynasty has always been Li Shanchang, but the Zhejiang Civil Service Group headed by Liu Bowen, Song Lian, and Wang Guangyang has always been the absolute main force in the civil service system of the Ming Dynasty.Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying have been urging Ma Xun to get married, and the reason is very simple.When you get older, you will naturally get married, start a family, start a business, and carry on the family line. This is an important task.Nowadays, many people get married at the age of fifteen or sixteen. Ma Xun is already twenty years old and is still alone. Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying look anxious.Ma Xun is worried. Is it because he wants to get married first and then fall in love?Before he could react, he got an official position - Captain in front of the tent.Ma Xun, who was called to Kunning Palace, asked, "Sister, I have no ability and no merit, so what's the point of getting an official position?" Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "I'll give it to you and you can continue. I see that you don't want to be a civil servant. I discussed it with your brother-in-law and gave you a military position first. You can go and experience it, so that you can become a general in the future."The pressure was high. "Sister, I don't know the military, how can I lead troops to fight?" Ma Xiuying said quickly, "Who asked you to lead troops to fight? The family still expects you to carry on the family lineage, how can they let you go to the battlefield? From now on, you will train troops, review, and reward the army for your brother-in-law." Ma Xun understood, this was to give him an official position mixed with military merit.Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "I met Liu Bowen's daughter today. She is good-looking and has a good temperament." Ma Xun was unable to resist, so she could only say, "Can I go and have a look? If we are suitable, we will get married. If we don't like it, let's look for another one?" Ma Xiuying decisively agreed, "MingTian asked Muying to come with you, you might as well take a look for yourself." Ma Xun asked again, "If I get married, wouldn't it be more appropriate to live outside?Anyway, we are in the capital, right under my nose, so I can come over at any time." Ma Xiuying became unhappy and asked, "Do you think we are treating you badly?""Okay, okay!" Ma Xun said quickly, "I'm used to being wild, and I always feel uncomfortable everywhere in the palace. I want to travel around, and I want to walk around, but I can't go anywhere in the palace." Ma Xiuying became even more unhappy, "I'll give you the warrant and the palace talisman, and you can walk around, who can stop you?With you?" Ma Xun said quickly, "Sister, this is the palace, how can I really run around?Besides, I'm going to have a family, so I can't live in the palace, right?How can others laugh at me?" This touched Ma Xiuying's heart, and it was really inappropriate for Ma Xun to live in the palace all the time.Letting him live here now is an expedient measure, just because Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying are worried about Ma Xun being alone in the capital.Zhu Yuanzhang came with big strides, "What's wrong? Are you two quarreling?" "I want to move out." Ma Xiuying said, "I thought about it, if I really get married, it will definitely not be possible for me to live in the palace forever.

He wants to wander around again, what do you say?"Zhu Yuanzhang subconsciously wanted to ask Ma Xun if he was a 'wolf-hearted dog', but he could understand it in a second thought.Ma Xun is young and it is inconvenient to live in the palace.The most important thing is that I will definitely feel uncomfortable living in my brother-in-law's house.Zhu Yuanzhang thought for a while and said, "Then I will find you a mansion and arrange some people to serve you. Don't just think about it. The Ming Dynasty was built in the early days, and there is still a war in the north. You should also contribute." Ma Xun looked at Ma Xiuying and asked tentatively, "Sister, do you occasionally have chest tightness and shortness of breath?" Ma Xiuying was stunned for a moment and asked, "How do you know?" Ma Xun became nervous and immediately asked, "At night and early in the morning.What's more?Fever, night sweats, rapid heartbeat, and frequent tinnitus?" It was Zhu Yuanzhang's turn to be nervous, "Brother, what's going on?How do you know this?" Ma Xun had a bad feeling in his heart, but he still said with reservations, "The old man was like this before, and said that his ancestors were also like this." Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying's expressions changed greatly. They had heard of Qi disease.This is a way of saying asthma, but Ma Xun is not sure now, especially since this thing cannot be eradicated even after hundreds of years, and it has a certain genetic inheritance.Zhu Yuanzhang's face was ashen, "Brother, don't scare me!" "Brother-in-law, how dare I talk nonsense about this matter!" Ma Xun said, "I have been thinking about this matter these days, and it will definitely not work if I don't talk about it. It's just a perfect way, I can't think of it now." Zhu Yuanzhang lost his mind for a while, "I'm going to kill those drunkards in the Imperial Hospital."Okay, Zhu Chongba!"Ma Xiuying regained her senses, "It's not like you don't know that when it comes to you and me, they just want nothing to do. How can they say I'm not sick? I'm fine now. They say it's really difficult to cure."Zhu Yuanzhang's eyes were red and he was breathing heavily.Ma Xiuying looked at Ma Xun and asked, "Brother, do you mean that this disease cannot be cured?" Ma Xun nodded solemnly, "They say eradication is difficult, but it is not difficult to control it, and it will not have a big impact on life span." "What does it mean if it cannot be cured?""Zhu Yuanzhang was furious and shouted, "I'm going to summon the best doctor in the world to see if this disease can be cured!" Ma Xiuying said in a louder voice, "Zhu Chongba!What is Qi disease?"
